Hyperventilation involves rapid breathing, which expels more carbon dioxide from the lungs.  
Less CO₂ in the blood means less carbonic acid forms (CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃ ⇌ H⁺ + HCO₃⁻), so hydrogen ion concentration decreases and blood becomes more alkaline.  
Thus, partial pressure of CO₂ decreases and hydrogen ion concentration decreases.  

Final answer: (B)
